Comment: Luminis glow for skin (bodies and faces). The glow comes from a glow layer: a texture (for example a PNG) where only the glowing parts are painted, in any colors, and everything else is transparent. Its colors are the glow colors; its transparency decides where it glows. Attach it with mtrl_luminis.py --glow-texture. Settings with intensity 0 never glow.

2657300338.Label: Glow tint
2657300338.Description: Multiplies the glow color. White keeps the glow layer's own colors.

2657300338.Label: Glow intensity
2657300338.Description: How bright the glow is. 0 turns Luminis off for this material. Lower values keep painted designs crisp; higher values bloom.

2469346156.Label: Dark start
2469346156.Description: Light level below which the glow is fully on (in dark mode). Lower = only glows in deeper darkness.

2469346156.Label: Dark end
2469346156.Description: Light level above which the glow is fully off (in dark mode). The gap between start and end sets how gradually it fades.

Values.Label: Always on
Values.Description: Ignores lighting.

Values.Label: Glow in darkness
Values.Description: Fades in as light drops.

Values.Label: Glow in light
Values.Description: Fades in as light rises.

2469346156.Label: Light sensitivity
2469346156.Description: How strongly the mode applies. 0 = always on regardless of mode, 1 = full effect.

654612545.Label: Color source
654612545.Description: 0 = tint only, 1 = the skin's own color (including tattoos underneath), 2 = the glow layer's colors (default), 3 = rainbow along the texture. In-between values blend.

654612545.Label: Area mix
654612545.Description: 0 = react to light hitting the skin (shadows, facing a lamp), 1 = react to the area's overall brightness only (steady while turning). 0.5 is a good balance.

654612545.Label: Glow area
654612545.Description: Which parts of the skin glow.

Values.Label: Glow layer
Values.Description: Where the glow layer texture is painted (not transparent).

Values.Label: Whole skin
Values.Description: All skin using this material.

654612545.Label: Debug view
654612545.Description: Replaces the eye with diagnostic information. Set back to Off when done.

Values.Label: Glow mask
Values.Description: White where the mask allows glow.

Values.Label: Light level
Values.Description: Gray value of the light the shader measures.

Values.Label: Light gate
Values.Description: White = glow fully on, black = off.

Values.Label: Glow only
Values.Description: Shows only the glow, without the lit eye.

Values.Label: Clock
Values.Description: Shows the game clock as a black-to-white sweep, one sweep per clock unit, to calibrate Speed.

Values.Label: Layer 2 mask
Values.Description: White where glow layer 2 would glow.

Values.Label: Layer 2 light gate
Values.Description: White where glow layer 2 is currently switched on by its glow mode.

2602692533.Label: Detail
2602692533.Description: 0 = flat glow, 1 = the skin's own light and dark pattern shows through the glow.

2602692533.Label: Detail gain
2602692533.Description: Brightens the detail pattern. Raise it if detail makes the glow too dim.

2602692533.Label: Rainbow length
2602692533.Description: How many times the rainbow repeats down the texture (color source 3). Negative values reverse it.

1057547936.Label: Animation
1057547936.Description: Makes the glow change over time.

Values.Label: Off
Values.Description: Steady glow.

Values.Label: Blink
Values.Description: Switches between the glow and nothing. Softness 0 = hard flash, 1 = smooth pulse.

Values.Label: Two-color
Values.Description: Alternates between Glow tint and Strobe color.

Values.Label: Color steps
Values.Description: Steps through evenly spaced rainbow colors (see Steps). Rainbow shift picks the starting color. Like Two-color, it keeps the surface's dark parts (such as the pupil) dark.

Values.Label: Chroma
Values.Description: Spins smoothly through the whole rainbow. On hair and skin, Rainbow length above 0 adds moving color bands. Like Two-color, it keeps the surface's dark parts (such as the pupil) dark.

Values.Label: Custom colors
Values.Description: Cycles through your own colors: Glow tint, Color 2, Color 3 and Color 4. Steps sets how many (2 to 4).

Values.Label: Pulse
Values.Description: Like Blink, but swings between Pulse minimum and Pulse maximum instead of switching off. Softness 1 = smooth breathing pulse.

Values.Label: Hue cycle
Values.Description: Every glow color rotates around the color wheel at once, keeping its place, so a painted rainbow gradient flows through the design. Uses the color source's own colors (Color source 2 for a glow layer).

1057547936.Label: Speed
1057547936.Description: Cycles per clock unit (see Debug view: Clock). Small values are slow; negative values run backwards.

1057547936.Label: Steps
1057547936.Description: Color steps: how many rainbow colors (2 to 12; 3 gives red, green, blue). Custom colors: how many of your colors to use (2 to 4).

1057547936.Label: Softness
1057547936.Description: 0 = hard switch between states, 1 = smooth fade.

3024841222.Label: Color 2 (strobe color)
3024841222.Description: The second color for Two-color and Custom colors. Glow tint is the first.

1443336009.Label: Color 3
1443336009.Description: The third color for Custom colors (used when Steps is 3 or 4).

1443336009.Label: pulse minimum
1443336009.Description: Pulse: the lowest brightness, as a fraction of the intensity. 0.15 = 15%; 0 = fades out completely like Blink.

3361938154.Label: Color 4
3361938154.Description: The fourth color for Custom colors (used when Steps is 4).

3361938154.Label: pulse maximum
3361938154.Description: Pulse: the highest brightness, as a fraction of the intensity. 1 = full intensity.

4190601817.Label: Layer 2 tint
4190601817.Description: Multiplies glow layer 2's painted colors. White keeps them as painted.

4190601817.Label: Layer 2 intensity
4190601817.Description: Brightness of glow layer 2. 0 turns layer 2 off.

4102788679.Label: Layer 2 dark start
4102788679.Description: Light level below which layer 2 glows fully (Glow in darkness).

4102788679.Label: Layer 2 dark end
4102788679.Description: Light level above which layer 2 stops glowing (Glow in darkness).

4102788679.Label: Layer 2 glow mode
4102788679.Description: When glow layer 2 glows, independently of layer 1.

Values.Label: Always on
Values.Description: Ignores lighting.

Values.Label: Glow in darkness
Values.Description: Fades in as light drops.

Values.Label: Glow in light
Values.Description: Fades in as light rises.

4102788679.Label: Layer 2 light sensitivity
4102788679.Description: How strongly layer 2's glow mode applies. 0 ignores lighting.

1190068539.Label: Layer 2 animation
1190068539.Description: Makes glow layer 2 change over time, independently of layer 1.

Values.Label: Off
Values.Description: Steady glow.

Values.Label: Blink
Values.Description: Switches between the glow and nothing. Softness 0 = hard flash, 1 = smooth pulse.

Values.Label: Two-color
Values.Description: Alternates between Glow tint and Strobe color.

Values.Label: Color steps
Values.Description: Steps through evenly spaced rainbow colors (see Steps). Rainbow shift picks the starting color. Like Two-color, it keeps the surface's dark parts (such as the pupil) dark.

Values.Label: Chroma
Values.Description: Spins smoothly through the whole rainbow. On hair and skin, Rainbow length above 0 adds moving color bands. Like Two-color, it keeps the surface's dark parts (such as the pupil) dark.

Values.Label: Custom colors
Values.Description: Cycles through your own colors: Layer 2 tint and Layer 2 colors 2 to 4. Steps sets how many (2 to 4).

Values.Label: Pulse
Values.Description: Like Blink, but swings between Pulse minimum and Pulse maximum instead of switching off. Softness 1 = smooth breathing pulse.

Values.Label: Hue cycle
Values.Description: Every glow color rotates around the color wheel at once, keeping its place, so a painted rainbow gradient flows through the design. Uses the color source's own colors (Color source 2 for a glow layer).

1190068539.Label: Layer 2 speed
1190068539.Description: Cycles per clock unit (see Debug view: Clock). Small values are slow; negative values run backwards.

1190068539.Label: Layer 2 steps
1190068539.Description: Color steps: how many rainbow colors (2 to 12; 3 gives red, green, blue). Custom colors: how many of your colors to use (2 to 4).

1190068539.Label: Layer 2 softness
1190068539.Description: 0 = hard switch between states, 1 = smooth fade.

191168796.Label: Layer 2 color 2
191168796.Description: Layer 2's second color for Two-color and Custom colors. Layer 2 tint is its first.

191168796.Label: Layer 2 color source
191168796.Description: Where layer 2's colors come from: 0 = Layer 2 tint only (pure animation colors, the painting only decides where it glows), 1 = the surface's own color, 2 = layer 2's painted colors (default), 3 = rainbow. In-between values blend.

2883213400.Label: Layer 2 color 3
2883213400.Description: Layer 2's third color for Custom colors (Layer 2 steps 3 or 4).

2883213400.Label: Layer 2 pulse minimum
2883213400.Description: Pulse: the lowest brightness, as a fraction of the intensity. 0.15 = 15%; 0 = fades out completely like Blink.

901697019.Label: Layer 2 color 4
901697019.Description: Layer 2's fourth color for Custom colors (Layer 2 steps 4).

901697019.Label: Layer 2 pulse maximum
901697019.Description: Pulse: the highest brightness, as a fraction of the intensity. 1 = full intensity.

764520549.Label: Luminis glow layer
764520549.Description: Glow layer for the skin: a texture painted over the body texture layout, for example glowing tattoos. Its colors are the glow colors; transparent parts don't glow. Used when Glow area is Glow layer.

4112668159.Label: Luminis glow layer 2
4112668159.Description: A second glow layer with its own intensity, tint, light behavior and animation (Luminis Layer 2 settings).
